restoration_note: The teaching describes the four great days (the Lord's outgoing in four registers: Father of Truth, Third Ambassador, Pillar of Glory/Omophoros, Jesus the Radiance) and four corresponding nights (self-states: Land of Darkness, Matter/Hyle, Worlds of Flesh, Law of Sin). Each day/night holds a twelvefold completeness. Most gaps are morphological — line-break completions of standard formulae (ⲙⲛⲧⲥⲛⲁⲩⲥⲉ ⲛⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩ, ⲡⲕⲁⲍ ⲙⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ, etc.) — and these are tightly restored from editor proposals. The substantive restorations (Omophoros, Living Spirit, the dwelling-places, Sin, Matter as image-painter and mother) follow the spiritual reading and standard Manichaean parallels. Heavy damage in sections 164, 167, 177, 210-216 leaves a cluster of mid-line lacunae unrestorable; honesty here is preferable to invention.
